name: Kalaburagi
registryBasis: Kalaburagi’s official district administration lists the city DDLR/land-records office and district registrar and links its Revenue services to Bhoomi land records. A Karnataka Legislative Council government reply lists an Assistant Director of Land Records City Survey, Kalaburagi and a Kalaburagi Sub-Registrar Office. This city-specific office evidence confirms registry/survey activity; the district-level modernization tables do not prove city parcel coverage.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
